SELECT s.`School`,
       f.`Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` / f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` AS `Eligible Free Rate (Ages 5-17)`
FROM `frpm` f
JOIN `schools` s ON f.`CDSCode` = s.`CDSCode`
WHERE s.`SOCType` = 'Continuation School'
   OR f.`School Type` = 'Continuation Schools (Public)'
ORDER BY `Eligible Free Rate (Ages 5-17)` ASC
LIMIT 3

SELECT School
FROM schools
WHERE Magnet = 1
  AND CDSCode IN (SELECT cds FROM satscores WHERE NumTstTakr > 500)
SELECT Phone FROM schools WHERE CDSCode = (SELECT cds FROM satscores ORDER BY NumGE1500 DESC LIMIT 1)
SELECT CDSCode FROM frpm WHERE `Enrollment (K-12)` + `Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` > 500

SELECT s.District, AVG(sc.AvgScrRead) AS avg_reading_score
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores sc ON s.CDSCode = sc.cds
WHERE s.StatusType = 'Active'
GROUP BY s.District
ORDER BY avg_reading_score DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores sc ON s.CDSCode = sc.cds
WHERE s.County = 'Alameda' AND s.StatusType = 'Merged' AND sc.NumTstTakr < 100;

SELECT sc.School, sc.CharterNum, st.AvgScrWrite
FROM satscores st
JOIN schools sc ON st.cds = sc.CDSCode
WHERE st.AvgScrWrite > 499
  AND sc.CharterNum IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY st.AvgScrWrite DESC;

SELECT T1.School, T1.FundingType
FROM schools AS T1
INNER JOIN satscores AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.cds
WHERE T1.County = 'Riverside'
GROUP BY T1.School, T1.FundingType
HAVING SUM(T2.AvgScrMath) * 1.0 / COUNT(T2.AvgScrMath) > 400

SELECT School, Street, City, State, Zip
FROM schools
WHERE CDSCode IN (
    SELECT CDSCode
    FROM frpm
    WHERE `FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)` > 800
      AND `School Type` = 'High Schools (Public)'
      AND CDSCode IN (
          SELECT CDSCode
          FROM schools
          WHERE County = 'Monterey'
      )
)

SELECT T2.School, T2.DOCType
FROM frpm AS T1
INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T2.FundingType = 'Locally funded'
  AND T1.`Enrollment (K-12)` - T1.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` > (
      SELECT AVG(T3.`Enrollment (K-12)` - T3.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`)
      FROM frpm AS T3
      INNER JOIN schools AS T4 ON T3.CDSCode = T4.CDSCode
      WHERE T4.FundingType = 'Locally funded'
  )

SELECT s.School,
       f.`Free Meal Count (K-12)` / f.`Enrollment (K-12)` AS eligible_free_rate
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
ORDER BY f.`Enrollment (K-12)` DESC
LIMIT 2 OFFSET 9;

SELECT `Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` / `Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` AS free_rate
FROM frpm
WHERE CDSCode = (
    SELECT CDSCode
    FROM schools
    WHERE (AdmFName1 = 'Kacey' AND AdmLName1 = 'Gibson')
       OR (AdmFName2 = 'Kacey' AND AdmLName2 = 'Gibson')
       OR (AdmFName3 = 'Kacey' AND AdmLName3 = 'Gibson')
)
SELECT AdmEmail1 FROM schools WHERE CDSCode = (SELECT CDSCode FROM frpm WHERE `Charter School (Y/N)` = 1 ORDER BY `Enrollment (K-12)` ASC LIMIT 1)
SELECT AVG(T1.NumTstTakr) FROM satscores AS T1 INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode WHERE T2.County = 'Fresno' AND strftime('%Y', T2.OpenDate) = '1980'

WITH max_school AS (
    SELECT cds
    FROM satscores
    WHERE NumGE1500 = (SELECT MAX(NumGE1500) FROM satscores)
)
SELECT s.AvgScrWrite, sc.City
FROM satscores s
JOIN schools sc ON s.cds = sc.CDSCode
WHERE s.cds IN (SELECT cds FROM max_school);

SELECT s.School
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.DOC = '31'
  AND f.`Enrollment (K-12)` = (
      SELECT MAX(f2.`Enrollment (K-12)`)
      FROM frpm f2
      JOIN schools s2 ON f2.CDSCode = s2.CDSCode
      WHERE s2.DOC = '31'
  );

       sch.MailStreet AS PostalStreet
FROM satscores sc
JOIN schools sch ON sc.cds = sch.CDSCode

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM satscores s 
JOIN schools sc ON s.cds = sc.CDSCode 
WHERE sc.MailCity = 'Lakeport'

WITH mike_schools AS (
  SELECT CDSCode, School
  FROM schools
  WHERE (AdmFName1 = 'Mike' AND AdmLName1 = 'Larson')
     OR (AdmFName2 = 'Mike' AND AdmLName2 = 'Larson')
     OR (AdmFName3 = 'Mike' AND AdmLName3 = 'Larson')
),
both_admins AS (
  SELECT s.CDSCode, s.School, s.Website
  FROM schools s
  WHERE ((s.AdmFName1 = 'Mike' AND s.AdmLName1 = 'Larson')
      OR (s.AdmFName2 = 'Mike' AND s.AdmLName2 = 'Larson')
      OR (s.AdmFName3 = 'Mike' AND s.AdmLName3 = 'Larson'))
    AND ((s.AdmFName1 = 'Dante' AND s.AdmLName1 = 'Alvarez')
      OR (s.AdmFName2 = 'Dante' AND s.AdmLName2 = 'Alvarez')
      OR (s.AdmFName3 = 'Dante' AND s.AdmLName3 = 'Alvarez'))
)
SELECT b.Website
FROM both_admins b
WHERE b.CDSCode IN (SELECT CDSCode FROM mike_schools);
SELECT Website FROM schools WHERE County = 'San Joaquin' AND Charter = 1 AND Virtual = 'P'

FROM comments c
INNER JOIN users u ON u.Id = c.UserId

SELECT ym.CustomerID, SUM(ym.Consumption) AS TotalConsumption
FROM yearmonth ym
JOIN customers c ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
WHERE c.Currency = 'LAM'
  AND ym.Date BETWEEN 201201 AND 201212
GROUP BY ym.CustomerID
ORDER BY TotalConsumption ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(*) AS CustomerCount
FROM (
    SELECT CustomerID, SUM(Consumption) AS TotalConsumption
    FROM yearmonth
    WHERE CustomerID IN (SELECT CustomerID FROM customers WHERE Segment = 'KAM')
      AND Date BETWEEN 201201 AND 201212
    GROUP BY CustomerID
) AS totals
WHERE TotalConsumption < 30000

SELECT c.Segment, SUM(y.Consumption) AS TotalConsumption
FROM yearmonth y
JOIN customers c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
GROUP BY c.Segment
ORDER BY TotalConsumption ASC
LIMIT 1;

WITH czk_totals AS (
    SELECT c.CustomerID, c.Segment, SUM(y.Consumption) AS TotalConsumption
    FROM customers c
    JOIN yearmonth y ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK' AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.CustomerID, c.Segment
),
segment_min AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(TotalConsumption) AS MinTotalConsumption
    FROM czk_totals
    GROUP BY Segment
),
lowest_customers AS (
    SELECT t.CustomerID, t.Segment, t.TotalConsumption
    FROM czk_totals t
    JOIN segment_min m ON t.Segment = m.Segment AND t.TotalConsumption = m.MinTotalConsumption
),
annual_avgs AS (
    SELECT Segment, SUM(TotalConsumption) / COUNT(CustomerID) AS AnnualAverageConsumption
    FROM lowest_customers
    GROUP BY Segment
)
SELECT
  MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'SME' THEN AnnualAverageConsumption END) - MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'LAM' THEN AnnualAverageConsumption END) AS "SME minus LAM",
  MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'LAM' THEN AnnualAverageConsumption END) - MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'KAM' THEN AnnualAverageConsumption END) AS "LAM minus KAM",
  MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'KAM' THEN AnnualAverageConsumption END) - MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'SME' THEN AnnualAverageConsumption END) AS "KAM minus SME"
FROM annual_avgs;

SELECT c.CustomerID
FROM customers c
JOIN yearmonth y ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
WHERE c.Segment = 'LAM'
  AND c.Currency = 'Euro'
  AND y.Date = 201310
ORDER BY y.Consumption DESC
LIMIT 1;
SELECT SUM(T2.Consumption) FROM customers AS T1 JOIN yearmonth AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID WHERE T1.Segment = 'KAM' AND T2.Date = 201305

WITH LAMConsumption AS (
  SELECT c.CustomerID, SUM(y.Consumption) AS TotalConsumption
  FROM customers c
  JOIN yearmonth y ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
  WHERE c.Segment = 'LAM'
  GROUP BY c.CustomerID
),
LAMAbove AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) AS LAMCustomersAbove
  FROM LAMConsumption
  WHERE TotalConsumption > 46.73
),
LAMTotal AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) AS TotalLAMCustomers
  FROM customers
  WHERE Segment = 'LAM'
)
SELECT (
  (SELECT LAMCustomersAbove FROM LAMAbove) * 100.0
  /
  (SELECT TotalLAMCustomers FROM LAMTotal)
) AS Percentage;
SELECT MAX(Consumption) FROM yearmonth WHERE SUBSTR(Date, 1, 4) = '2012'

SELECT MAX(MonthlyConsumption) AS BiggestMonthlyConsumption
FROM (
    SELECT SUM(ym.Consumption) / 12 AS MonthlyConsumption
    FROM yearmonth ym
    JOIN customers c ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR'

) t

FROM customers c
JOIN (

    FROM transactions_1k

FROM transactions_1k t
JOIN customers c ON t.CustomerID = c.CustomerID

(SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CustomerID) FROM transactions_1k WHERE Date = '2012-08-25')

SELECT
  (SELECT SUM(T1.Amount * T1.Price)
   FROM transactions_1k AS T1
   JOIN gasstations AS T2 ON T1.GasStationID = T2.GasStationID
   WHERE T1.CustomerID = 38508) AS total_spent,
  (SELECT SUM(T1.Amount * T1.Price)
   FROM transactions_1k AS T1
   JOIN gasstations AS T2 ON T1.GasStationID = T2.GasStationID
   WHERE T1.CustomerID = 38508 AND T1.Date = '201201') AS jan_2012_spent

WITH top_customer AS (
    SELECT CustomerID
    FROM transactions_1k
    GROUP BY CustomerID
    ORDER BY SUM(Price) DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT tr.CustomerID,
       SUM(tr.Price) / SUM(tr.Amount) AS avg_price_per_item,
       c.Currency
FROM transactions_1k tr
JOIN top_customer tc ON tr.CustomerID = tc.CustomerID
JOIN customers c ON c.CustomerID = tc.CustomerID
GROUP BY tr.CustomerID, c.Currency;

FROM Player p

SELECT DISTINCT team_fifa_api_id FROM Team_Attributes WHERE buildUpPlaySpeed > 50 AND buildUpPlaySpeed < 60

      SELECT (SELECT SUM(buildUpPlayPassing) FROM Team_Attributes WHERE strftime('%Y', date) = '2012' AND buildUpPlayPassing IS NOT NULL) * 1.0 /
             (SELECT COUNT(T2.team_long_name) FROM Team_Attributes AS TA2 JOIN Team AS T2 ON TA2.team_api_id = T2.team_api_id WHERE strftime('%Y', TA2.date) = '2012' AND TA2.buildUpPlayPassing IS NOT NULL)
  );
SELECT SUM(long_shots) / COUNT(player_fifa_api_id) FROM Player_Attributes WHERE player_api_id = (SELECT player_api_id FROM Player WHERE player_name = 'Ahmed Samir Farag')

SELECT P.player_name

    GROUP BY c.Segment, y.CustomerID
),
lowest AS (
    SELECT Segment,
           SUM(total_consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS annual_avg
    FROM (
        SELECT Segment,
               total_consumption,
               MIN(total_consumption) OVER (PARTITION BY Segment) AS min_cons
        FROM totals
    )
    WHERE total_consumption = min_cons
    GROUP BY Segment
)
SELECT
    MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'SME' THEN annual_avg END)
      - MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'LAM' THEN annual_avg END) AS diff_SME_LAM,
    MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'LAM' THEN annual_avg END)
      - MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'KAM' THEN annual_avg END) AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'KAM' THEN annual_avg END)
      - MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'SME' THEN annual_avg END) AS diff_KAM_SME
FROM lowest;

WITH totals AS (
  SELECT c.CustomerID, c.Segment, SUM(y.Consumption) AS total
  FROM customers c
  JOIN yearmonth y ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
  WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK' AND substr(y.Date, 1, 4) = '2013'
  GROUP BY c.CustomerID, c.Segment
),
minima AS (
  SELECT Segment, MIN(total) AS min_total
  FROM totals
  GROUP BY Segment
),
averages AS (
  SELECT t.Segment, SUM(t.total) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS avg_cons
  FROM totals t
  JOIN minima m ON m.Segment = t.Segment AND m.min_total = t.total
  GROUP BY t.Segment
)
SELECT
  (SELECT avg_cons FROM averages WHERE Segment = 'SME') - (SELECT avg_cons FROM averages WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS SME_LAM,
  (SELECT avg_cons FROM averages WHERE Segment = 'LAM') - (SELECT avg_cons FROM averages WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS LAM_KAM,

FROM (
    SELECT MIN(a1.element, a2.element) AS e1,

           COUNT(DISTINCT c.bond_id) AS cnt
    FROM connected c
    JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
    JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id

);

WITH czk AS (
    SELECT c.Segment, y.CustomerID, SUM(y.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM yearmonth y
    JOIN customers c ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK' AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.Segment, y.CustomerID
),
mn AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(total_consumption) AS min_consumption
    FROM czk
    GROUP BY Segment
),
avgc AS (
    SELECT czk.Segment, SUM(czk.total_consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS annual_avg
    FROM czk
    JOIN mn ON czk.Segment = mn.Segment AND czk.total_consumption = mn.min_consumption

)

SELECT c.atom_id, c.atom_id2
FROM connected c

SELECT DISTINCT a2.atom_id
FROM atom a1
JOIN connected c ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON a2.atom_id = c.atom_id2
WHERE a1.element = 'pb'
UNION
SELECT DISTINCT a2.atom_id
FROM atom a1
JOIN connected c ON c.atom_id2 = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON a2.atom_id = c.atom_id
WHERE a1.element = 'pb'

SELECT MAX(cnt) * 100.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bond) AS percentage
FROM (
  SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM bond b
  JOIN connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
  JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
  JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
  GROUP BY a1.element, a2.element
)
SELECT ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(b.bond_id), 5) FROM bond b JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id WHERE b.bond_type = '-';
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT atom.element) FROM atom JOIN bond ON atom.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id WHERE bond.bond_type = '-'
SELECT label FROM molecule WHERE molecule_id = 'TR000' OR molecule_id = 'TR001' OR molecule_id = 'TR002'

);

WITH avg_diff AS (
    SELECT AVG(f."Enrollment (K-12)" - f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)") AS avg_d
    FROM frpm f
    JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
    WHERE s.FundingType = 'Locally funded'
)
SELECT s.School, s.DOC
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
CROSS JOIN avg_diff a
WHERE s.FundingType = 'Locally funded'
  AND (f."Enrollment (K-12)" - f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)") > a.avg_d;

JOIN yearmonth y ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
WHERE c.Segment = 'LAM' AND y.Date BETWEEN 201201 AND 201212
GROUP BY c.CustomerID
ORDER BY TotalConsumption ASC
LIMIT 1;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers WHERE Segment = 'KAM' AND CustomerID IN (SELECT CustomerID FROM yearmonth WHERE Date BETWEEN 201201 AND 201212 GROUP BY CustomerID HAVING SUM(Consumption) < 30000);

SELECT c.Segment, SUM(y.Consumption) AS total_consumption

SELECT
  MAX(CASE WHEN a.seg = 'SME' THEN a.avg_c END) - MAX(CASE WHEN a.seg = 'LAM' THEN a.avg_c END) AS SME_minus_LAM,
  MAX(CASE WHEN a.seg = 'LAM' THEN a.avg_c END) - MAX(CASE WHEN a.seg = 'KAM' THEN a.avg_c END) AS LAM_minus_KAM,
  MAX(CASE WHEN a.seg = 'KAM' THEN a.avg_c END) - MAX(CASE WHEN a.seg = 'SME' THEN a.avg_c END) AS KAM_minus_SME
FROM (
  SELECT t.seg AS seg,
         SUM(t.tot) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT t.cid) AS avg_c
  FROM (
    SELECT y.CustomerID AS cid, c.Segment AS seg, SUM(y.Consumption) AS tot
    FROM yearmonth y
    JOIN customers c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK' AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY y.CustomerID, c.Segment
  ) t
  JOIN (
    SELECT u.seg AS seg, MIN(u.tot) AS min_tot
    FROM (
      SELECT y2.CustomerID AS cid, c2.Segment AS seg, SUM(y2.Consumption) AS tot
      FROM yearmonth y2
      JOIN customers c2 ON y2.CustomerID = c2.CustomerID
      WHERE c2.Currency = 'CZK' AND y2.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
      GROUP BY y2.CustomerID, c2.Segment
    ) u
    GROUP BY u.seg
  ) m ON m.seg = t.seg AND m.min_tot = t.tot
  GROUP BY t.seg
) a;

    JOIN Team AS T2 ON TA2.team_api_id = T2.team_api_id

    FROM Team_Attributes
    WHERE buildUpPlayDribblingClass = 'Normal'

      AND date <= '2014-01-31 00:00:00'

SELECT DISTINCT
    a.account_id,
    dhigh.A11 - d.A11 AS gap
FROM client c
JOIN disp dp ON dp.client_id = c.client_id
JOIN account a ON a.account_id = dp.account_id
JOIN district d ON d.district_id = c.district_id
LEFT JOIN client older ON older.gender = 'F' AND older.birth_date > c.birth_date
LEFT JOIN district lower_sal ON lower_sal.A11 < d.A11
CROSS JOIN district dhigh
LEFT JOIN district higher_sal ON higher_sal.A11 > dhigh.A11
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
  AND older.client_id IS NULL
  AND lower_sal.district_id IS NULL
  AND higher_sal.district_id IS NULL;

JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
JOIN trans t ON t.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE d.A3 = 'North Bohemia'
  AND t.bank = 'AB';

SELECT COUNT(c.client_id)
FROM client c
JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE d.A2 = 'Hl.m. Praha' AND c.gender = 'M';

SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN c.type = 'gold' AND c.issued < '1998-01-01' THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS percent_gold_before_1998
FROM card c

SELECT c.type
FROM client cl
JOIN disp d ON cl.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN card c ON d.disp_id = c.disp_id
WHERE cl.client_id = 13539;

SELECT d.A3
FROM client c
JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE c.client_id = 3541;

SELECT 100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.gender = 'F' THEN c.client_id END) / COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS pct_women
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district di ON a.district_id = di.district_id
WHERE di.A11 > 10000;

SELECT (SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(T1.date, 1, 4) = '1997' THEN T1.amount ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(T1.date, 1, 4) = '1996' THEN T1.amount ELSE 0 END)) * 100.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(T1.date, 1, 4) = '1996' THEN T1.amount ELSE 0 END) AS growth_rate
FROM loan AS T1
JOIN account AS T2 ON T1.account_id = T2.account_id
JOIN disp AS T3 ON T2.account_id = T3.account_id
JOIN client AS T4 ON T3.client_id = T4.client_id
WHERE T4.gender = 'M';

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN d.A3 = 'north Bohemia' THEN CAST(d.A16 AS INTEGER) ELSE 0 END)
     - SUM(CASE WHEN d.A3 = 'east Bohemia' THEN CAST(d.A16 AS INTEGER) ELSE 0 END) AS crime_difference
FROM district d
WHERE d.A3 IN ('north Bohemia', 'east Bohemia');

SELECT strftime('%Y', client.birth_date) AS birth_year
FROM client
JOIN disp ON disp.client_id = client.client_id
WHERE client.client_id = 130
  AND disp.type = 'OWNER';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id)
FROM account a
JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id
WHERE d.type = 'OWNER'
  AND a.frequency = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU';

SELECT l.amount AS debt, l.payments, l.status, l.duration
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON d.client_id = c.client_id
JOIN loan l ON l.account_id = d.account_id
WHERE c.client_id = 992;

SELECT SUM(t.amount) AS total_paid
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN trans t ON d.account_id = t.account_id
WHERE c.client_id = 617
  AND t.type = 'VYDAJ'
  AND (t.date LIKE '1998%' OR t.date LIKE '98%');

SELECT COUNT(a.account_id)
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE d.A2 = 'Beroun'
  AND CAST(SUBSTR(a.date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) > 1996;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id)
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE l.duration = 24
  AND a.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE'
  AND l.status = 'A';

SELECT DISTINCT c.client_id AS client_id,
       CAST((julianday('now') - julianday(c.birth_date)) / 365.25 AS INTEGER) AS age
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON d.client_id = c.client_id
JOIN card cd ON cd.disp_id = d.disp_id
WHERE cd.type = 'gold'
  AND d.type = 'OWNER';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_id) AS num_students
FROM member m
JOIN major mj ON m.link_to_major = mj.major_id
WHERE mj.college LIKE '%Engineering%';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.link_to_member) AS num_students
FROM attendance a
JOIN event e ON a.link_to_event = e.event_id
WHERE e.event_name = 'Women''s Soccer';

SELECT DISTINCT m.phone
FROM member m
JOIN attendance a ON m.member_id = a.link_to_member
JOIN event e ON a.link_to_event = e.event_id
WHERE e.event_name = 'Women''s Soccer';

SELECT e.event_name
FROM event e
JOIN attendance a ON e.event_id = a.link_to_event
GROUP BY e.event_id, e.event_name
ORDER BY COUNT(a.link_to_member) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) AS num_events
FROM member m
JOIN attendance a ON a.link_to_member = m.member_id
JOIN event e ON e.event_id = a.link_to_event
WHERE m.first_name = 'Sacha'
  AND m.last_name = 'Harrison'
  AND strftime('%Y', e.event_date) = '2019';
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM event WHERE type = 'Meeting' AND event_id IN (SELECT link_to_event FROM attendance GROUP BY link_to_event HAVING COUNT(link_to_member) > 10);

SELECT e.event_name
FROM event e
JOIN attendance a ON a.link_to_event = e.event_id
WHERE e.type != 'Fundraiser'
GROUP BY e.event_id, e.event_name
HAVING COUNT(e.event_id) > 20;

SELECT COUNT(a.link_to_member) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_name) AS average_attendance
FROM event e
JOIN attendance a ON a.link_to_event = e.event_id
WHERE e.type = 'Meeting' AND strftime('%Y', e.event_date) = '2020';

SELECT m.first_name, m.last_name
FROM member m
JOIN attendance a ON m.member_id = a.link_to_member
JOIN event e ON a.link_to_event = e.event_id
WHERE e.event_name = 'Laugh Out Loud'

SELECT SUM(b.spent) AS total_spent
FROM budget b
JOIN event e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
WHERE b.category = 'Food' AND e.event_name = 'September Meeting';

SELECT z.city, z.state
FROM member m
JOIN zip_code z ON m.zip = z.zip_code
WHERE m.position = 'President';
SELECT notes FROM income WHERE source = 'Fundraising' AND date_received = '2019-09-14'

SELECT m.phone
FROM member m
LEFT JOIN major ma ON m.link_to_major = ma.major_id
WHERE m.first_name = 'Carlo' AND m.last_name = 'Jacobs';

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM budget 
JOIN event ON budget.link_to_event = event.event_id 
WHERE event.event_name = 'November Meeting' AND budget.remaining < 0

SELECT SUM(b.amount) AS total_budget_amount
FROM budget b
JOIN event e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
WHERE e.event_name = 'September Speaker';

SELECT COUNT(m.member_id)
FROM member m
JOIN major ma ON m.link_to_major = ma.major_id
WHERE ma.major_name = 'Business' AND m.t_shirt_size = 'Medium'

SELECT m.first_name || ' ' || m.last_name AS full_name
FROM income i
JOIN member m ON i.link_to_member = m.member_id
WHERE i.source = 'Dues'
ORDER BY i.date_received ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN b.category = 'Parking' THEN b.amount ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / SUM(b.amount) AS parking_budget_percentage
FROM budget AS b
JOIN event AS e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
WHERE e.event_name = 'November Speaker';

SELECT SUM(e.cost) AS total_pizza_cost
FROM expense e
JOIN budget b ON e.link_to_budget = b.budget_id
WHERE e.expense_description = 'Pizza';

SELECT z.city, z.county, z.state
FROM member m
JOIN zip_code z ON m.zip = z.zip_code
WHERE m.first_name = 'Amy' AND m.last_name = 'Firth'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_id)
FROM member m
JOIN zip_code z ON m.zip = z.zip_code
WHERE z.state = 'Maryland';
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM event WHERE type = 'Meeting' AND strftime('%Y', event_date) = '2020';

SELECT DISTINCT m.first_name, m.last_name
FROM member m
JOIN expense ex ON ex.link_to_member = m.member_id
JOIN budget b ON ex.link_to_budget = b.budget_id
JOIN event e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id

SELECT m.t_shirt_size
FROM member m
LEFT JOIN major ma ON m.link_to_major = ma.major_id

LIMIT 1;

SELECT e.event_name
FROM event e
JOIN budget b ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event

ORDER BY b.remaining ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT b.category, SUM(b.amount) AS amount_budgeted
FROM budget b
JOIN event e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
WHERE e.event_name = 'April Speaker'
GROUP BY b.category
ORDER BY amount_budgeted ASC;
SELECT e.event_name FROM budget b JOIN event e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id WHERE b.category = 'Food' ORDER BY b.amount DESC LIMIT 1;
SELECT SUM(T1.cost) FROM expense AS T1 WHERE T1.expense_description = 'Parking'
SELECT SUM(T1.cost) FROM expense AS T1 LEFT JOIN budget AS T2 ON T1.link_to_budget = T2.budget_id WHERE T1.expense_date = '2019-08-20'

SELECT major.major_name
FROM member
JOIN major ON member.link_to_major = major.major_id
WHERE member.first_name = 'Phillip' AND member.last_name = 'Cullen';

SELECT DISTINCT m.position
FROM member m
JOIN major mj ON m.link_to_major = mj.major_id
WHERE mj.major_name = 'Business';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_members
FROM member
JOIN major ON member.link_to_major = major.major_id
WHERE major.major_name = 'Business' AND member.t_shirt_size = 'Medium';

SELECT b.category
FROM event e
JOIN budget b ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event
WHERE e.event_date = '2020-03-24T12:00:00';

SELECT major.major_name
FROM member
JOIN major ON member.link_to_major = major.major_id
WHERE member.position = 'Vice President'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM income LEFT JOIN member ON income.link_to_member = member.member_id WHERE income.amount = 50;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_majors
FROM major
WHERE major.college = 'College of Agriculture and Applied Sciences'
  AND major.department = 'School of Applied Sciences, Technology and Education';

SELECT DISTINCT zip_code.city, zip_code.state
FROM member
JOIN major ON member.link_to_major = major.major_id
JOIN zip_code ON member.zip = zip_code.zip_code
WHERE major.department = 'Electrical and Computer Engineering Department'
  AND member.position = 'Member';

SELECT DISTINCT m.last_name
FROM member m
JOIN attendance a ON m.member_id = a.link_to_member
JOIN event e ON a.link_to_event = e.event_id
WHERE e.event_name = 'Women''s Soccer' AND m.position = 'Member';
SELECT event_name FROM event WHERE type = 'Game' AND status = 'Closed' AND event_date BETWEEN '2019-03-15' AND '2020-03-20'

SELECT m.first_name, m.last_name, a.link_to_event
FROM member m
JOIN expense e ON e.link_to_member = m.member_id
JOIN attendance a ON a.link_to_member = m.member_id
WHERE e.approved = 'true'
  AND e.expense_date BETWEEN '2019-01-10' AND '2019-11-19';

SELECT DISTINCT m.email
FROM member m
JOIN expense e ON e.link_to_member = m.member_id
WHERE e.cost > 20
  AND e.expense_date BETWEEN '2019-09-10' AND '2019-11-19';

SELECT COUNT(m.member_id)
FROM member m
JOIN major mj ON m.link_to_major = mj.major_id
WHERE mj.major_name = 'Education'
  AND mj.college = 'College of Education & Human Services'
  AND m.position = 'Member';
SELECT expense_description FROM expense GROUP BY expense_description HAVING SUM(cost) / COUNT(expense_id) > 50;

SELECT SUM(ex.cost) * 1.0 / COUNT(ev.event_id) AS average_amount_paid
FROM expense ex
JOIN member m ON ex.link_to_member = m.member_id
JOIN budget b ON ex.link_to_budget = b.budget_id
JOIN event ev ON b.link_to_event = ev.event_id
WHERE m.position != 'Member';

SELECT m.first_name, m.last_name
FROM member m
JOIN expense e ON m.member_id = e.link_to_member
GROUP BY m.member_id, m.first_name, m.last_name
ORDER BY MAX(e.cost) DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT DISTINCT m.first_name, m.last_name, m.phone
FROM member m
JOIN expense e ON e.link_to_member = m.member_id
CROSS JOIN (SELECT AVG(cost) AS avg_cost FROM expense) a
WHERE e.cost > a.avg_cost;

SELECT m.major_name AS major, m.department
FROM member mem
JOIN major m ON mem.link_to_major = m.major_id
WHERE mem.first_name = 'Garrett' AND mem.last_name = 'Gerke';

SELECT m.last_name, m.phone
FROM member m
JOIN major mj ON m.link_to_major = mj.major_id
WHERE mj.major_name = 'Elementary Education';

SELECT m.first_name, m.last_name, mj.college
FROM member m
JOIN major mj ON m.link_to_major = mj.major_id
WHERE m.position = 'Secretary';

SELECT SUM(b.spent) AS total_spent, e.event_name
FROM budget b
JOIN event e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
WHERE b.category = 'Speaker Gifts'
GROUP BY e.event_name;

SELECT z.city
FROM member m
JOIN zip_code z ON m.zip = z.zip_code
WHERE m.first_name = 'Garrett' AND m.last_name = 'Gerke';

SELECT superhero.full_name
FROM superhero
JOIN hero_power ON hero_power.hero_id = superhero.id
JOIN superpower ON superpower.id = hero_power.power_id
GROUP BY superhero.id, superhero.full_name
HAVING COUNT(superhero.full_name) > 15;

SELECT COUNT(s.id) AS num_superheroes
FROM superhero s
JOIN colour c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id
WHERE c.colour = 'Blue';

SELECT superhero.superhero_name, superhero.height_cm, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY superhero.height_cm DESC) AS rank FROM superhero JOIN publisher ON superhero.publisher_id = publisher.id WHERE publisher.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' ORDER BY superhero.height_cm DESC

SELECT COUNT(s.id) AS num_superheroes
FROM superhero s
JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
WHERE p.publisher_name = 'DC Comics';

SELECT s.superhero_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_attribute ha ON ha.hero_id = s.id
JOIN attribute a ON a.id = ha.attribute_id
WHERE a.attribute_name = 'Intelligence'
ORDER BY ha.attribute_value ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT ROUND(SUM(a.alignment = 'Bad') * 100.0 / COUNT(s.id), 2) AS percentage,
       SUM(CASE WHEN p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' AND a.alignment = 'Bad' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS marvel_count
FROM superhero s
LEFT JOIN alignment a ON s.alignment_id = a.id
LEFT JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id;

SELECT p.id
FROM publisher p
WHERE p.publisher_name = 'Star Trek'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM superhero WHERE full_name IS NULL;

SELECT c.colour
FROM superhero s
JOIN colour c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id

SELECT AVG(s.weight_kg) FROM superhero s JOIN gender g ON s.gender_id = g.id WHERE g.gender = 'Female'

SELECT s.superhero_name
FROM superhero s

SELECT superhero.superhero_name
FROM superhero
JOIN colour ON superhero.eye_colour_id = colour.id
WHERE superhero.height_cm BETWEEN 170 AND 190
  AND colour.colour = 'No Colour';

SELECT s.full_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id

JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id
JOIN colour c ON s.hair_colour_id = c.id

  AND LOWER(r.race) = 'human';

SELECT DISTINCT p.power_name
FROM hero_power hp
JOIN superpower p ON hp.power_id = p.id
WHERE hp.hero_id = 1;

SELECT s.full_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_attribute ha ON ha.hero_id = s.id
JOIN attribute a ON a.id = ha.attribute_id
WHERE a.attribute_name = 'strength'
ORDER BY ha.attribute_value DESC
LIMIT 1;
SELECT COUNT(T1.id) / SUM(T1.skin_colour_id = 1) FROM superhero AS T1 JOIN colour AS T2 ON T1.skin_colour_id = T2.id

SELECT s.superhero_name, r.race
FROM superhero s
JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id
WHERE s.full_name = 'Charles Chandler';

SELECT s.height_cm
FROM superhero s
JOIN colour c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id
WHERE c.colour = 'Amber';

SELECT DISTINCT c_eye.colour AS eye_colour
FROM superhero s
JOIN colour c_skin ON s.skin_colour_id = c_skin.id
JOIN colour c_eye ON s.eye_colour_id = c_eye.id
WHERE c_skin.colour = 'Gold';

SELECT s.full_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id
WHERE r.race = 'Vampire';

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN g.gender = 'Female' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS percent
FROM superhero s
JOIN gender g ON s.gender_id = g.id
JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
WHERE p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics';

SELECT SUM(superhero.height_cm) * 1.0 / COUNT(superhero.id) AS average_height
FROM superhero;

SELECT COUNT(*)

JOIN publisher ON superhero.publisher_id = publisher.id 
WHERE publisher.id = 1;

SELECT c.colour
FROM superhero s
JOIN colour c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id
WHERE s.full_name = 'Karen Beecher-Duncan';

SELECT p.publisher_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
WHERE s.id = 38;

SELECT a.alignment, sp.power_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN alignment a ON s.alignment_id = a.id
JOIN hero_power hp ON hp.hero_id = s.id
JOIN superpower sp ON sp.id = hp.power_id

SELECT s.superhero_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_attribute ha ON ha.hero_id = s.id
WHERE ha.attribute_value BETWEEN 75 AND 80;

SELECT DISTINCT race.race
FROM superhero
JOIN colour ON superhero.hair_colour_id = colour.id
JOIN gender ON superhero.gender_id = gender.id
JOIN race ON superhero.race_id = race.id
WHERE colour.colour = 'blue'

SELECT SUM(T3.id = 2) * 100.0 / COUNT(T1.id)
FROM superhero AS T1
JOIN alignment AS T2 ON T1.alignment_id = T2.id
JOIN gender AS T3 ON T1.gender_id = T3.id

SELECT ha.attribute_value
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_attribute ha ON ha.hero_id = s.id
JOIN attribute a ON a.id = ha.attribute_id
WHERE s.superhero_name = 'Hulk'
  AND a.attribute_name = 'Strength';

SELECT COUNT(s.id) AS num_green_skinned_villains
FROM superhero s
JOIN colour c ON s.skin_colour_id = c.id
JOIN alignment a ON s.alignment_id = a.id
WHERE c.colour = 'Green'

FROM superhero s
JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id
JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
WHERE r.race <> 'Human'
  AND p.publisher_name = 'Dark Horse Comics';

JOIN attribute ON hero_attribute.attribute_id = attribute.id
JOIN superhero ON hero_attribute.hero_id = superhero.id
WHERE attribute.attribute_name = 'Speed'
  AND hero_attribute.attribute_value = 100;
SELECT superhero_name FROM superhero WHERE full_name = 'Charles Chandler';

FROM superhero AS T1

ORDER BY T2.attribute_value ASC
LIMIT 1;
SELECT full_name FROM superhero WHERE weight_kg < 100 AND eye_colour_id IN (SELECT id FROM colour WHERE colour = 'Brown');

SELECT s.weight_kg, r.race
FROM superhero s
JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id
WHERE s.id = 40;

SELECT AVG(s.height_cm) AS average_height
FROM superhero s
JOIN alignment a ON s.alignment_id = a.id
WHERE a.alignment = 'Neutral';

SELECT s.id
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_power hp ON s.id = hp.hero_id
JOIN superpower sp ON hp.power_id = sp.id
WHERE sp.power_name = 'Intelligence';

SELECT DISTINCT T3.power_name
FROM superhero AS T1
JOIN hero_power AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.hero_id
JOIN superpower AS T3 ON T2.power_id = T3.id
CROSS JOIN (SELECT AVG(height_cm) * 0.8 AS threshold FROM superhero) AS T4
WHERE T1.height_cm > T4.threshold;

SELECT
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.Admission = '+' THEN p.ID END) AS male_inpatient,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.Admission = '-' THEN p.ID END) AS male_outpatient,
  100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.Admission = '+' THEN p.ID END) / COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.Admission = '-' THEN p.ID END) AS deviation_percentage
FROM Patient p
LEFT JOIN Laboratory l ON l.ID = p.ID
WHERE p.SEX = 'M';

SELECT 100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.Admission = '+' THEN p.ID END) / COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS inpatient_percentage
FROM Patient p
LEFT JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID
WHERE substr(p.Birthday, 1, 4) BETWEEN '1930' AND '1940';

SELECT DISTINCT p.ID, CAST(strftime('%Y', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', p.Birthday) AS INTEGER) AS age
FROM Patient p
JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID
WHERE e.RVVT = '+';

SELECT DISTINCT p.ID, p.SEX, p.Diagnosis
FROM Patient p
JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID
WHERE e.Thrombosis = 2;

SELECT DISTINCT p.ID, p.SEX, p.Diagnosis
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.ALB < 3.5;

SELECT MAX(strftime('%Y', Patient.Birthday)) - MIN(strftime('%Y', Patient.Birthday)) AS age_gap
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.TG >= 200;

SELECT MIN(l.`Date`) AS lab_date,
       CAST(strftime('%Y', p.`First Date`) AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', p.Birthday) AS INTEGER) AS age
FROM Patient AS p
JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID
WHERE p.Diagnosis = 'SJS'
GROUP BY p.ID
ORDER BY p.Birthday ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT AVG(1999 - CAST(strftime('%Y', p.Birthday) AS INTEGER))
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.Date BETWEEN '1991-10-01' AND '1991-10-30';

SELECT E."aCL IgM"
FROM Patient P
JOIN Examination E ON P.ID = E.ID
WHERE P.Diagnosis = 'SLE'
  AND P.Description = '1994-02-19'
  AND E."Examination Date" = '1993-11-12';

SELECT p.SEX
FROM Laboratory l
JOIN Patient p ON l.ID = p.ID
WHERE l.Date = '1992-06-12' AND l.GPT = '9';

SELECT CAST(strftime('%Y', l.Date) AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', p.Birthday) AS INTEGER) AS age
FROM Laboratory l
JOIN Patient p ON l.ID = p.ID
WHERE l.UA = '8.4' AND l.Date = '1991-10-21';

SELECT p."Diagnosis"
FROM Examination e
JOIN Patient p ON e."ID" = p."ID"
WHERE e."Examination Date" = '1997-01-27'
  AND e."Diagnosis" = 'SLE';
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID) FROM Patient JOIN Examination ON Patient.ID = Examination.ID WHERE Patient.SEX = 'F' AND strftime('%Y', Patient.Birthday) = '1964' AND Patient.Admission = '+';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT e.ID)
FROM Patient p
JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID
CROSS JOIN (SELECT AVG(`aCL IgM`) AS avg_igm FROM Examination) a
WHERE e.Thrombosis = 2
  AND e.ANA = 'S'
  AND e.`aCL IgM` > a.avg_igm + a.avg_igm * 0.2;

SELECT DISTINCT P.SEX
FROM Patient P
JOIN Examination E ON P.ID = E.ID
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE E.Diagnosis = 'PSS'
  AND L.CRP > 2
  AND L.CRE = 1
  AND L.LDH = 123;

SELECT E.Symptoms
FROM Examination AS E
JOIN Patient AS P ON E.ID = P.ID
WHERE P.Diagnosis = 'SLE' AND E.Symptoms IS NOT NULL AND E.Symptoms != '--'
GROUP BY E.Symptoms
ORDER BY COUNT(E.Symptoms) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT DISTINCT p.Description, p.Diagnosis
FROM Patient p
JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID
WHERE p.ID = 48473;
SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN T1.SEX = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(T1.SEX) FROM Patient AS T1 WHERE strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday) = '1980' AND T1.Diagnosis = 'RA'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID)
FROM Patient p
JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID
WHERE p.SEX = 'M'
  AND e."Examination Date" BETWEEN '1995' AND '1997'
  AND p.Diagnosis = 'Behcet disease'
  AND p.Admission = '-';

SELECT CAST(JULIANDAY((SELECT MIN("Examination Date") FROM Examination WHERE ID IN (SELECT ID FROM Patient WHERE ID = 821298 AND SEX = 'F'))) - JULIANDAY((SELECT "First Date" FROM Patient WHERE ID = 821298 AND SEX = 'F')) AS INTEGER);
SELECT AVG(L.LDH) FROM Laboratory L JOIN Patient P ON L.ID = P.ID WHERE L.LDH < 500;

SELECT (SELECT ID FROM Patient WHERE Birthday = '1982-04-01') AS ID,
       (SELECT CASE WHEN ALP < 300 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END
        FROM Laboratory
        WHERE ID IN (SELECT ID FROM Patient WHERE Birthday = '1982-04-01')
        ORDER BY Date DESC LIMIT 1) AS "ALP within normal range"

SELECT L.TP - 8.5 AS deviation
FROM Laboratory L
JOIN Patient P ON L.ID = P.ID
WHERE P.SEX = 'F' AND L.TP > 8.5

SELECT DISTINCT p.ID, p.SEX, p.Birthday
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE p.SEX = 'M'
  AND (l.ALB <= 3.5 OR l.ALB >= 5.5)
ORDER BY p.Birthday DESC;

SELECT p.ID, p.Birthday, l.Date, l.ALB,
       CASE WHEN l.ALB BETWEEN 3.5 AND 5.5 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS Albumin_Within_Normal_Range
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE strftime('%Y', p.Birthday) = '1982';

SELECT AVG(L.UA)
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON L.ID = P.ID
LEFT JOIN Laboratory L2 ON L2.ID = L.ID AND L2.Date > L.Date
WHERE L2.ID IS NULL
  AND ((P.SEX = 'M' AND L.UA < 8.0) OR (P.SEX = 'F' AND L.UA < 6.5));

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID, T1.SEX, T1.Birthday
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Diagnosis = 'RA' AND T2.UN < 30;

SELECT SUM(Patient.SEX = 'M') > SUM(Patient.SEX = 'F')
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.CRE >= 1.5;

SELECT P.SEX, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT P.ID)
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L."T-BIL" >= 2.0
GROUP BY P.SEX;

SELECT p.ID, l."T-CHO"
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
ORDER BY l."T-CHO" DESC, p.Birthday ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT l.ID)
FROM Laboratory l
JOIN Examination e ON l.ID = e.ID
WHERE l.APTT > 45 AND e.Thrombosis = 0;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Patient.Birthday > '1980-01-01'
  AND (Laboratory.FG < 150 OR Laboratory.FG > 450);

SELECT DISTINCT T1.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.`U-PRO` >= 30;
SELECT DISTINCT p.ID FROM Patient p JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID WHERE l."U-PRO" > 0 AND l."U-PRO" < 30 AND p.Diagnosis = 'SLE'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Laboratory.ID)
FROM Laboratory
JOIN Patient ON Laboratory.ID = Patient.ID
WHERE Laboratory.IGG >= 2000;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID)
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID
WHERE l.IGG > 900 AND l.IGG < 2000 AND e.Symptoms IS NOT NULL;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID)
FROM Laboratory L
JOIN Patient P ON L.ID = P.ID
WHERE L.CRP = '+' AND P.Description IS NULL

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID)
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.CRE >= 1.5
  AND CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', p.Birthday) AS INTEGER) < 70;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
JOIN Examination ON Patient.ID = Examination.ID
WHERE Laboratory.RA IN ('-', '+-')
  AND Examination.KCT = '+';

SELECT DISTINCT p.ID
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.RF < 20
  AND CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', p.Birthday) AS INTEGER) > 60;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Patient.Diagnosis = 'APS' AND Laboratory.C4 > 10;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID)
FROM Patient p
JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID
WHERE e.SM IN ('-', '+-') AND e.Thrombosis = 0;

SELECT DISTINCT e.ID
FROM Examination e
JOIN Patient p ON e.ID = p.ID
WHERE e.`Examination Date` > '1997-01-01'
  AND e.SC170 IN ('negative', '0');
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ID) FROM Patient WHERE SEX = 'F' AND ID IN (SELECT ID FROM Laboratory WHERE SC170 IN ('negative', '0')) AND ID IN (SELECT ID FROM Examination WHERE Symptoms IS NULL)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.SSA IN ('-','+-') AND CAST(strftime('%Y', T1.`First Date`) AS INTEGER) < 2000;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT l.ID) FROM Laboratory l JOIN Patient p ON l.ID = p.ID WHERE l.DNA < 8 AND p.Description IS NULL;

SELECT CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN Patient.Diagnosis = 'SLE' THEN Laboratory.ID END) AS REAL) * 1.0 / COUNT(Laboratory.ID) AS percentage
FROM Laboratory
JOIN Patient ON Laboratory.ID = Patient.ID
WHERE Laboratory.GOT >= 60;
SELECT MAX(T1.Birthday) FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.GOT >= 60

SELECT MIN(P.`First Date`)
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.LDH < 500
GROUP BY P.ID
ORDER BY MAX(L.LDH) DESC
LIMIT 1;
SELECT T1.Date FROM Laboratory AS T1 JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.ALB > 3.5 AND T1.ALB < 5.5 ORDER BY T1.ALB DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Patient.SEX = 'M'
  AND Laboratory.ALB > 3.5
  AND Laboratory.ALB < 5.5
  AND Laboratory.TP BETWEEN 6.0 AND 8.5
SELECT MAX(T1.ANA) FROM Examination AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.CRE < 1.5

SELECT P.ID
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID
JOIN Examination AS E ON P.ID = E.ID
WHERE L.CRE < 1.5
ORDER BY E."aCL IgA" DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT l.ID)
FROM Laboratory l
JOIN Examination e ON l.ID = e.ID
WHERE l.`T-BIL` >= 2.0
  AND e.`ANA Pattern` LIKE '%P%';

SELECT p.Diagnosis
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.TG < 200
ORDER BY l.TG DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT b.bond_type
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
GROUP BY b.bond_type
ORDER BY COUNT(b.bond_id) DESC
LIMIT 1;
